_about: BEE star labels stuck on by pipeline/build3d/add_label.mjs. Each label is this model's own (sources in each product's research notes). Sizes: fridge labels 90 mm wide (the 2026-28 layout, as measured on LG GL-B257 / GLT4626 / GV-B23), washer labels 64 mm (LG FHP1412's, measured). Placement: Daikin and Lloyd from Sangeetha's and the maker's photos; the rest have no photo of the sticker on the unit, so they sit where the other fridges and washers on the site carry theirs (top door, upper corner; washer front, top right beside the door).

lg-t70ajmb1z.note: LG's own label image for T70AJMB1Z (gallery, 2024-26 series, 0.0083 kWh/kg/cycle, 7.0 kg). Placed where LG's front photo shows it: front, right, its top 659 mm above the floor and its centre 214 mm right of the middle; 64 mm wide like the other washer labels.

lg-gl-s312spzy.note: GL-S312SPZY's own entry in BEE's register (2026-28 series, 1 star, 271 units a year, 272 L), redrawn on LG's own 2026-28 template. Placed where LG's front photo shows its label: the freezer door's top right, under the LG mark, its middle 493 mm from the left and its top 72 mm below the door's top; 90 mm wide like the other fridge labels.

samsung-wa80bg4441bdtl.note: Samsung's own label images for WA80BG4441BDTL and, for Light Gray, WA80BG4441BGTL (gallery, 2024-26 series, 0.0083 kWh/kg/cycle, 8.0 kg). Placed where Samsung's front photo shows it: front, right, its centre 167 mm right of the middle and 680 mm above the floor; 64 mm wide like the other washer labels.

ifb-senator-mbn-8012-cms.note: IFB's own label artwork for SENATOR MBN 8012 CMS/2025 (product page gallery; period 1 Jan 2024 to 31 Dec 2026). No photo shows the sticker on the unit: it sits where the Serena's and the Executive Plus's do, on the front's top right beside the door.

haier-hw70-im12929bk.note: Haier's own BEE label for HW70-IM12929BK (model/year HW70-IM12929BK/2024, label period 1 Jan 2024 to 31 Dec 2026, 5 star, 0.0450 kWh/kg/cycle, 7.0 kg), from Haier's product image on its marketplace listing; BEE's register agrees (5 star, valid to 31 Dec 2026). No photo shows where it sits on the machine, so it goes on the front's top right, clear of the door (STANDARD 5a): its top 105 mm under the band's top edge, its centre 260 mm right of the middle; 64 mm wide like the other washer labels.

lg-t80spmb1z.note: LG's own label image for T80SPMB1Z (gallery, 2024-26 series, 0.0079 kWh/kg/cycle, 8.0 kg; Sangeetha's listing carries the same model's full label, period 1 Jan 2024 - 31 Dec 2026, with the same figures). Placed where LG's front photo shows it: front, right, its top about 687 mm above the floor and its centre 212 mm right of the middle; 64 mm wide like the other washer labels.
